title: 资产购买协议的标的构成
issue: 十巡2011年判决逐字：“The parties signed the APA in September 1995 but the transaction did not close until December of that year.”，注脚明言实际买方为“Santa Cruz, a predecessor company to SCO”；大纲所记 1995-09-19 签署与 1995-12-06 交割与之相合。

title: 版权保留条款的具体所指
issue: 十巡判决逐字：“Novell retained the right to the royalties collected by SCO on SVRX licenses with a 5% administrative fee”，且 APA 原文“specifically excluded ‘[a]ll copyrights and trademarks, except for the trademarks UNIX and UnixWare’”——版税保留与版权排除同条并存。

title: 商标权不随资产转让
issue: APA 的商标处理为“[a]ll copyrights and trademarks, except for the trademarks UNIX and UnixWare”（十巡逐字）——UNIX 与 UnixWare 两标系被点名的例外而非排除；UNIX 认证商标今归 Open Group（其法务 FAQ 定正确署名），UnixWare 产品商标随资产归 Xinuos（UnXis 公告自称保留“the UNIX and UNIXWARE trademarks”）。“注册于 Open Group 名下”对 UnixWare 不成立。〔已采纳落账 2026-11-01〕
suggested_title: UNIX 商标的另持与 APA 商标例外（1995）

title: UnixWare 产品线的归属转移
issue: UnXis 公告（2011-04-11）逐字：“UnXis now owns all intellectual property rights and assets related to SCO”；现 sco.com 即 Xinuos 官网，以 UnixWare 7 名义列产品。注：承接时名为 UnXis，2013 年更名 Xinuos。

title: 交割后的权属碎片化
issue: 三方分立各有一手：版权归 Novell（十巡：“The jury found Novell had not transferred the copyrights to SCO”）；UNIX 商标归 Open Group（官网：“The UNIX trademark is owned and managed by The Open Group on behalf of the industry”）；产品线与客户合同归继受方 Xinuos（UnXis 公告）。

title: SVR5 内核的产品延续
issue: 已查 Xinuos 官网产品索引页（仅列类目未涉内核沿革）与十巡、二巡判决（未涉），未见“OpenServer 6 以 SVR5 内核承载”之表述；维基仅作线索不作定案。建议补引 SCO/Xinuos 产品技术文档或 UnixWare 7 白皮书原文再定。〔2026-11-03 存疑清零：内核沿革无一手，题面改取证阻断〕

title: 产品商标的现持有人
issue: UnXis 公告逐字：“UnXis has retained all customer contracts, the UNIX and UNIXWARE trademarks and an installed base of 32,000 customer contracts maintained in 82 countries”。注：UNIX 认证商标仍归 Open Group（法务 FAQ），产品商标归 Xinuos，两持并存。

title: 企业客户的迁移路径
issue: “迁移惯性”“客户去留决定存续期”为经营概括，无可核单一事实；可证底座为客户合同整体移交（UnXis 公告：32,000 份合同、82 国）与员工留任。目录核查通过。

title: 遗产产品收入与诉讼开支
issue: “诉讼专项受限资金”未见于已取文书（十巡 2011、二巡 2026 简易令、UnXis 公告、Xinuos 官网）；应有出处为 SCO 财报——已核 SEC EDGAR 存在 SCO Group Inc（CIK 0001102542）10-K 申报记录，原文未及调阅，禁编造。〔2026-11-03 存疑清零：财报未调阅，题面改待核〕

title: 三类权利的归属分工
issue: 三类权利各有其主逐条落实：商标归 Open Group（官网明文）；版权归 Novell 一系（十巡：“a jury determined Novell owned the copyrights”）；产品线归继受方 Xinuos（UnXis 公告“owns all intellectual property rights and assets related to SCO”）。

title: 商标许可与源码许可的分立
issue: Open Group 法务 FAQ 承认承前时代逐字：“Some licenses (which date from before the merger of X/Open Company with The Open Group) still require the following attribution: ‘UNIX is a registered trademark in the United States and other countries, licensed exclusively through X/Open Company Ltd.’”；源码许可另订 SVRX 三层协议结构（十巡判决引 APA 原文）。

title: 认证权与商标权的同源
issue: Open Group 认证页逐字：“Only systems that are fully compliant and certified according to the Single UNIX Specification are qualified to use the UNIX® trademark.”——认证即商标使用之门，认证权为商标许可权之延伸。

title: 权利分离对产品命名的约束
issue: 法律推断题（命名受制于他人商标与认证门槛），无单一可核事实；事实前提已证：经认证方可用 UNIX 商标（Open Group 认证页逐字）。

title: 分离安排在诉讼中的意义
issue: 综合推断题；“源码归属之争独立于商标之争”与实然进程相容（SCO v. Novell 只争版权归属，UNIX 商标始终在 Open Group 手中），判为体例题。

title: 起诉 IBM 的索赔规模
issue: 索赔逐年加码而非 2003 年即五十亿：2003-03 原诉请十亿美元（Pinsent Masons：“in March this year launched a $1 billion lawsuit against IBM”）；2003-06 修正诉状“SCO is seeking at least $3 billion”（同文逐字）；五十亿系 2004-02 二次修正诉状获准后（Neowin：“A judge has accepted the SCO Group’s changes to a lawsuit against IBM that now seeks $5 billion”；Pinsent Masons：“increasing the claim from $3 billion to a possible $5 billion”）。〔已采纳落账 2026-11-01〕
suggested_title: 起诉 IBM 的索赔加码（2003—2004）

title: 对 Linux 用户的授权主张
issue: 十巡判决逐字：“SCO sought to aggressively ‘market’ UNIX licenses to users of Linux”且“SCO sent warning letters to Linux users (including Novell) asserting rights to part of the Linux code”——主张对象确从厂商扩展至终端用户。

title: 资产继受的承接主体
issue: 二巡 2026 简易令逐字：“In January 2011, in connection with its bankruptcy proceeding, SCO Group sold almost the entirety of its software business to Xinuos pursuant to an Asset Purchase Agreement”与“In March 2011, the bankruptcy court approved the asset sale”；UnXis 公告称 2011-04-11 交割完成。注：承接时名义为 UnXis（2013 年更名 Xinuos）；对 IBM 等诉讼权利按 APA“Excluded Assets”明文排除——诉讼主体与资产主体分离有据。

title: 诉讼费用的资金安排
issue: “受限资金被指定支付专家与顾问费用”未见于已取一手（十巡、二巡、UnXis 公告、Xinuos 官网）；须核 SCO 财报原文（SEC EDGAR CIK 0001102542 之 10-K/10-Q），禁编造。〔2026-11-03 存疑清零：财报未调阅，题面改待核〕

title: 亏损累积与破产申请
issue: 破产申请 2007 年已证（二巡逐字：“In 2007, SCO Group filed for bankruptcy in the District of Delaware.”）；但“半年净亏损逾两百万美元且经营现金流为负”未见于已取文书，须核 EDGAR 10-Q 原文后定。〔2026-11-03 存疑清零：亏损数字待核，题面收至破产前记载〕

title: 版权归属的初审与上诉
issue: 十巡判决逐字回溯两级走向：“In the first appeal, we reversed a summary judgment in favor of Novell because questions of material fact remained”与“On remand, after a two-week trial, a jury determined Novell owned the copyrights”，并终局“We affirm.”。

title: 源码比对的技术举证
issue: 方法与举证结构题；修正诉状将争点具体化到代码领域（LWN 2003-06-17：PowerPC port、clustering、NUMA、read-copy-update 等）可证；“逐份文件比对”之清单化进程（2006 年 Wells 令）未及调阅原文，判为体例题。

title: 诉讼时效与主张期限
issue: 二巡 2026 简易令逐字：“The JDA included a statute of limitations provision, pursuant to which the parties agreed that any claim ‘related to a breach of [the JDA] must be commenced no later than two (2) years from the date of the breach.’”，并认定即使适用版权法三年时效“Xinuos’s copyright claim filed in 2021 would still be time-barred”——时效先于实体主张生效。

title: 多线诉讼的合并与分立
issue: 三线各有载体：SCO v. IBM 与 SCO v. Novell（犹他，十巡 2011）；Red Hat 一线系 Red Hat 2003-08-04 起诉 SCO（sco.com 存档页逐字：“Red Hat, Inc. filed suit against The SCO Group, Inc. on August 4, 2003 seeking declaratory judgment of non-infringement of copyrights”），Red Hat 并列名 Xinuos 2021 案被告（二巡 caption）。建议将“对”改“与”以免误读为 SCO 起诉 Red Hat。
suggested_title: SCO 与 IBM、Novell、Red Hat 的多线诉讼

title: 判决与 Linux 采用的走势
issue: 因果与走势断言（“未改变 Linux 采用曲线”“成为开源合规讨论的常见案例”）无单一一手可核；已查 FSF/SFC 执行原则文件与本案判决文书均未载此判断；建议正文降格为叙述性编者判断。〔2026-11-03 存疑清零：走势判断无一手，题面明标编者判断〕

title: 遗产产品的现持有人
issue: sco.com 现为 Xinuos 官网（“Xinuos, Inc., a new company... created to acquire all the operating assets and intellectual property rights of The SCO Group”），产品页列 OpenServer 与 UnixWare 线；交割由 UnXis 公告证。

title: 商标许可的存续状态
issue: Open Group 官网逐字：“The UNIX trademark is owned and managed by The Open Group on behalf of the industry”，法务 FAQ 定正确署名“The correct attribution is: ‘UNIX is a registered trademark of The Open Group in the United States and other countries’”——UNIX 商标许可关系存续；产品商标归 Xinuos。

title: 老客户的技术支持安排
issue: “支持以既有版本为限”未见一手表述；可证底座为客户合同与员工整体承接（UnXis 公告），判为体例概括题。

title: 法律争议的收尾节点
issue: 二巡简易令（No. 25-1073）2026-08-10 宣判逐字：“it is hereby ORDERED, ADJUDGED, and DECREED that the judgment of the district court is AFFIRMED”，并认定时效抗辩成立（“time-barred”）——以时效而非实体判决收尾。注：该件为 summary order（无先例效力），“最后一线”以此为限。

title: 遗产形态的收缩与维持
issue: “收缩到少数企业版本而维护承诺不变”为概括题；已取回的产品索引页仅列类目，未见维护承诺原文，判为体例题。

title: 许可条件的可执行性
issue: 联邦巡回法院逐字：“Having determined that the terms of the Artistic License are enforceable copyright conditions”及“The clear language of the Artistic License creates conditions to protect the economic rights at issue in the granting of a public license.”

title: 版权侵权与违约的分界
issue: 判决逐字：“a ‘copyright owner who grants a nonexclusive license to use his copyrighted material waives his right to sue the licensee for copyright infringement’ and can sue only for breach of contract. If, however, a license is limited in scope and the licensee acts outside the scope, the licensor can bring an action for copyright infringement.”

title: 许可条件的通知功能
issue: 判决逐字：“By requiring that users copy and restate the license and attribution information, a copyright holder can ensure that recipients of the redistributed computer code know the identity of the owner as well as the scope of the license granted by the original owner.”

title: 公共许可的协作基础
issue: 判决逐字：“Open Source software projects invite computer programmers from around the world to view software code and make changes and improvements to it.”及“In exchange and in consideration for this collaborative work, the copyright holder permits users to copy, modify and distribute the software code subject to conditions that serve to protect downstream users and to keep the code accessible.”

title: 约束力的司法确认路径
issue: 诉讼史实然顺序：初审以违约定性驳回禁令（“Because a breach of contract creates no presumption of irreparable harm, the District Court denied the motion for a preliminary injunction.”），上诉改判版权条件并发回（“We vacate and remand.”）——两条路径先后适用于同一许可。

title: 许可与契约的性质之辩
issue: Artifex 案双轨并诉（N.D. Cal. 2017-09-12 命令逐字）：“Artifex alleges two claims for relief: (1) breach of contract, and (2) copyright infringement.”；与 Jacobsen 案条件／契约两分框架（CAFC）相接。

title: 违约自认与争点收缩
issue: 无“自认违约”一手：Hancom 部分简易判决动议限于救济范围且以条件句表述（其拟议令：“if Plaintiff ultimately proves that Hancom is liable for breach of the contract”）；案件 2017-12-12 和解通知、2018-01-17 合意撤诉结案（卷宗逐字：“Date Terminated: Jan. 17, 2018”）。〔已采纳落账 2026-11-01〕
suggested_title: 争点收缩到救济范围（案结和解）

title: 对价关系中的协作投入
issue: 判决逐字：“The choice to exact consideration in the form of compliance with the open source requirements of disclosure and explanation of changes, rather than as a dollar-denominated fee, is entitled to no less legal recognition.”——协作投入即许可对价。

title: 商业许可作为估值参照
issue: 起诉状确以商业许可价目估算（命令引诉状逐字：“unjust enrichment... exceeds $75,000 based on the reasonable royalty rates under which Artifex commercially licenses Ghostscript”），法院仅驳回被告方排除该索赔的动议；“不得整体施加商业条款”系被告论点，法院未作实体认定，案件和解撤诉。〔已采纳落账 2026-11-01〕
suggested_title: 商业许可价目作为索赔估算参照

title: 终止后义务的存续
issue: 命令逐字：“Plaintiff... maintains that Hancom’s second download of Ghostscript means it again entered into a GPL on April 22, 2011, and at a minimum, that Hancom thereafter breached this license when it distributed software using Ghostscript without the source code or offer of source code.”——按次发生论经简易判决阶段存活。

title: 案件事实与系争许可
issue: 判决事实段：Decoder Commander 使用 DecoderPro 定义文件而缺五项标注——“did not comply with the terms of the Artistic License”（未含作者名、JMRI 版权声明、COPYING 文件指引、来源标识与修改说明）。

title: 初审法院的定性分歧
issue: 判决引初审原文逐字：“Defendants’ alleged violation of the conditions of the license may have constituted a breach of the nonexclusive license, but does not create liability for copyright infringement where it would not otherwise exist.”并因“a breach of contract creates no presumption of irreparable harm”驳回临时禁令。

title: 联邦巡回法院的改判
issue: 判决逐字：“we vacate and remand”及“Having determined that the terms of the Artistic License are enforceable copyright conditions, we remand to enable the District Court to determine whether Jacobsen has demonstrated (1) a likelihood of success on the merits...”——临时禁令举证框架随之重置。

title: 案件管辖的技术原因
issue: 判决逐字：“Jacobsen’s operative complaint... included not only his claim for copyright infringement, but also claims seeking a declaratory judgment that a patent issued to Katzer is not infringed by Jacobsen and is invalid. Therefore the complaint arose in part under the patent laws.”——因附带专利无效宣告诉讼而入联邦巡回法院，与许可争点无关。

title: 条件与契约的区分
issue: 判决逐字：“The heart of the argument on appeal concerns whether the terms of the Artistic License are conditions of, or merely covenants to, the copyright license.”及“If they are merely covenants, by contrast, they are governed by contract law.”

title: 版权救济的可得性
issue: 判决逐字：“It is outside the scope of the Artistic License to modify and distribute the copyrighted materials without copyright notices and a tracking of modifications from the original computer files.”——越界即属侵权，救济不再取决于合同约定。

title: 禁令与损害赔偿的选择
issue: 判决逐字：“Copyright licenses are designed to support the right to exclude; money damages alone do not support or enforce that right.”且“these types of license restrictions might well be rendered meaningless absent the ability to enforce through injunctive relief”——救济以禁令为轴。

title: 条件违反的举证负担
issue: 判决逐字：“the District Court did not make factual findings on the likelihood of success on the merits in proving that Katzer/Kamind violated the conditions of the Artistic License”——举证负担退回地区法院。

title: 救济范围与下游用户
issue: 判决逐字：“subject to conditions that serve to protect downstream users and to keep the code accessible”及“downstream users know about the collaborative effort to improve and expand the SourceForge project”——条件设计本为保护下游。

title: 案件事实与双许可模式
issue: 命令逐字：“uses a dual licensing model. Licensees can enter into a commercial license agreeing to pay Artifex a certain royalty fee, or they can license Ghostscript under a free open source license.”且“Defendant’s website stated that it licensed Ghostscript under the GPL”而“never distributed or offered to provide the source code for its Hangul or Hancom Office software”。注：2013 年前开源轨为 GPL、其后 AGPL。

title: 部分简易判决的争点
issue: 动议名即“Motion for Partial Summary Judgment on the Monetary Relief Available to Artifex on its Breach of Contract Claim”；命令逐字：“Defendant has not established as a matter of law that it is entitled to judgment in its favor as to the relief available to Plaintiff on the breach of contract claim.”——争点确限于可得救济。

title: 违约赔偿的计算基准
issue: 案内无“前者获准、后者被拒”之认定：法院仅驳回被告以法律问题限缩救济的动议（“The motion for summary judgment on this basis is therefore denied.”），赔偿基准未及实体裁定——案件 2017-12-12 和解通知、2018-01-17 合意撤诉（卷宗逐字：“Date Terminated: Jan. 17, 2018”）。〔已采纳落账 2026-11-01〕
suggested_title: 赔偿基准之争与和解结案

title: 源码提供义务的持续性
issue: 命令引 GPL 文本逐字：“Section 6 of the GPL requires licensors to distribute or offer to provide copies of source code for all software in the product that is covered by the license.”注：该案适用 GPLv3（第 6 条源码随附）；GPLv2 源码条款为第 3 条。

title: 判决结果与后续执行
issue: 无判决亦无执行：卷宗逐字“Date Filed: Dec. 5, 2016”“Date Terminated: Jan. 17, 2018”，此前 2017-12-12 为“Notice of Settlement”，随后“Stipulation of Dismissal with Prejudice”获准；被告亦无“自认违约”表述。〔已采纳落账 2026-11-01〕
suggested_title: 以和解撤诉结案（2018 年 1 月）

title: 源码提供义务的条款基础
issue: GPLv2 第 2 条 b 项逐字（BusyBox 诉状引）：“You must cause any work that you distribute or publish, that in whole or in part contains or is derived from the Program or any part thereof, to be licensed as a whole at no charge to all third parties under the terms of this License.”但 GPLv2 源码随附条款为第 3 条（诉状同引“a) Accompany it with the complete corresponding machine-readable source code”），第 6 条系下游自动获授权条款——“第 2 条 b 项＋第 6 条”混用了 v2 与 v3 两版条文。〔已采纳落账 2026-11-01〕
suggested_title: 整体授权与源码提供的条款基础

title: 执行的机构化转向
issue: 机构化有据：SFLC 以法律中心代理开发者起诉（2007 首例）；Conservancy 官网逐字：“Conservancy’s primary work in copyleft compliance currently focuses on our Strategic GPL Enforcement Initiative. This initiative, launched in October 2020”，并载 2012 年 5 月设立“GPL Compliance Project for Linux Developers”。

title: 合规优先的执行原则
issue: FSF 执行原则逐字：“Our primary goal in GPL enforcement is to bring about GPL compliance.”及“Legal action is a last resort. Compliance actions are primarily education and assistance processes to aid those who are not following the license.”

title: 执行与诉讼的取舍
issue: SFLC 公告逐字：“filed the first ever U.S. copyright infringement lawsuit based on a violation of the GNU General Public License (GPL)”——首例即以侵权之诉提起；FSF 原则并明言诉讼为最后手段。

title: 用户权利在执行中的位置
issue: FSF 原则逐字：“We require all redistributors to follow the GPL’s requirements in order to protect all the users’ freedom”及“No other ancillary goals should supersede full compliance with the GPL and respect for users’ freedoms”——执行以用户自由为的。

title: 首例 GPL 侵权诉讼
issue: SFLC 公告（2007-09-20）逐字：“filed the first ever U.S. copyright infringement lawsuit based on a violation of the GNU General Public License (GPL) on behalf of its clients, two principal developers of BusyBox, against Monsoon Multimedia, Inc.”——诉由为下游未获源码。

title: 下游取源义务的争点
issue: 公告逐字：“One of the conditions of the GPL is that re-distributors of BusyBox are required to ensure that each downstream recipient is provided access to the source code of the program.”且被告“has not provided any recipients with access to the underlying source code”。

title: 禁令请求的救济限度
issue: 公告逐字：“The complaint... requests that an injunction be issued... It also requests that damages and litigation costs be awarded to the plaintiffs.”诉状并请求扣押与律师费（“injunctive relief pursuant to 17 U.S.C. § 502”“recover their attorneys’ fees and costs of suit”）。

title: 案件管辖与案号登记
issue: 公告逐字：“The lawsuit, ‘Erik Andersen and Rob Landley v. Monsoon Multimedia Inc.,’ case number 07-CV-8205, will be heard by Senior District Judge John E. Sprizzo of the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York.”

title: 后续系列案件的处置
issue: 和解公告（2007-10-30）逐字：Monsoon 同意“appoint an Open Source Compliance Officer... to publish the source code... and to undertake substantial efforts to notify previous recipients”；Conservancy 并载“past lawsuits against more than a dozen defendants, and hundreds of non-litigation compliance actions”——系列案件以和解与合规承诺为主。

title: 庭外合规的优先取向
issue: FSF 原则逐字：“Legal action is a last resort.”及“mutually agreed terms that fix (or at least cease) further distribution and address damage already done are much better than a battle in court.”

title: 执行原则的共同声明
issue: FSF 执行原则页（2015-09-30）明示两组织共同奉行；Conservancy 官网逐字：“Conservancy has co-published, with the Free Software Foundation (FSF), the principles that both organizations follow in their compliance efforts.”

title: 判决与和解的取舍
issue: Monsoon 和解公告无“自认违约”表述：其对价是任命合规官、公布源码、通知既往接收者并支付未披露金额（“The settlement also includes an undisclosed amount of financial consideration paid by Monsoon Multimedia to the plaintiffs.”）——以合规承诺换撤诉。〔已采纳落账 2026-11-01〕〔C8b/D3 适配后定题：以合规承诺换撤诉的和解方式〕
suggested_title: 以合规承诺换撤诉的和解路径

title: 合规成本的分担机制
issue: 成本落点有据：Monsoon 支付未披露金额对价（和解公告）；FSF 原则逐字：“Copyright holders (or their designated agent) therefore are reasonable to request compensation for the cost of their time providing the compliance education”。“成本结构决定整改抑或诉讼”为编者推断，正文宜降格。

title: 争议收束的标志事件
issue: 收束机制实为撤回上诉而非“不上诉”：LG München I 2007-07 判决 Skype 违反 GPL，Skype 上诉后于 2008-05 撤回（heise 逐字：“Skype hat seine Berufung gegen ein im Juli 2007 ergangenes Urteil wegen Verletzung der GPL zurückgezogen”，此后“das im Sommer vergangenen Jahres ergangene Urteil jetzt gültig ist”）；系德国首例针对境外厂商的 GPL 判决（“erstmals in Deutschland ein ausländischer Anbieter wegen GPL-Verstoßes verurteilt worden”）。JIPITEC 亦证此为“the single case in Germany, in which a GPL infringer appealed a District Court decision”。〔已采纳落账 2026-11-01〕〔C8b/D3 适配后定题：德国争议以上诉撤回告终〕
suggested_title: 德国争议以上诉撤回告终（Skype 案，2008）

title: 德国诉讼的程序特征
issue: 首审即实体裁判而非程序驳回：LG München I 2004-05-19 判决逐字：“The Preliminary Injunction ordered by the Munich District Court I on the 2nd of April 2004, no. 6123/04, is upheld.”并明言“The Panel has no doubts as to the validity of the conditions set forth in GPL No. 2 and 3.”——GPL 效力经实体认定；JIPITEC 定评其为“a violation of the GPL results in a copyright infringement”之判。“两级法院均以程序理由驳回”与一手相悖。〔已采纳落账 2026-11-01〕〔C8b/D3 适配后定题：Welte 诉 Sitecom 禁令案（2004）〕
suggested_title: Welte 诉 Sitecom：德国首例 GPL 禁令（2004）

title: 请求人资格与贡献规模
issue: 判决逐字：“The plaintiff is a member of the open source project ‘netfilter/iptables’ and, as a so-called ‘maintainer’, the chief person in charge of software development”且“the plaintiff is at least co-author of the software in question”——以个人贡献者／共同作者身份起诉，PPTP 与 IRC helper 系其“entirely and exclusively programmed”。

title: 中国案件的许可变更事实
issue: 最高法（2021）知民终 2063 号逐字：“涉案软件从2016年7月8日的版本开始引入开源协议，起初为LGPL3.0协议，2016年8月12日更换为GPL3.0协议。2017年10月29日，罗盒公司在VirtualApp后续开源版本中删除‘适用GPL3.0协议’的表述。”——一次更换（同判决公证记录记“2016年9月10日，Lody将LGPL3.0协议变更为GPL3.0协议”）加逾一年后删除，非“数月内两次变更许可”。〔已采纳落账 2026-11-01〕〔C8b/D3 适配后定题：VirtualApp 案的许可引入与删除〕
suggested_title: VirtualApp 案的许可引入、更换与删除（2016—2017）

title: 许可文本的跨法域效力
issue: 广州知产法院 207 号判决逐字：“对违反开源软件许可协议的行为存在违约救济和侵权救济两种方式”且“从上述美国和德国案例分析可知，其均是将违反开源软件许可协议的授权许可条件义务纳入侵权责任的调整范围。”——同一 GPL 文本在美德中三法域循不同救济分类；美国为版权条件（CAFC）、德国为附解除条件之许可（LG München）。

title: 执行路径的差异比较
issue: 德国以个人为轴（JIPITEC 逐字：“the enforcement of the GPL license conditions is driven by single developers... Most famous is Mr. Harald Welte”）；美国以机构为轴（Conservancy：“Strategic GPL Enforcement Initiative”“hundreds of non-litigation compliance actions”）。

title: 源码提供义务的举证
issue: 条款文本即举证起点：Artifex 命令引 GPL 第 6 条全文句（见 V72.4.5.4）；BusyBox 诉状逐字引 GPLv2 第 3 条“a) Accompany it with the complete corresponding machine-readable source code”。

title: 分发行为的证据链
issue: 诉状逐字：“Defendant offers copies of the Firmware on its website, but does not offer any source code corresponding to the Firmware.”；SFLC 公告并载被告官网自认产品固件含 BusyBox（“has publicly acknowledged that its products and firmware contain BusyBox”）——分发与不附源码皆可逐件指认。

title: 代码上传记录的证据力
issue: 最高法 2063 号以公证 GitHub 记录为凭，逐字：“Lody于2016年7月7日在GitHub网站上传了VirtualApp的初始源代码共计31097行，次日附加了LGPL3.0协议。”——上传行数与许可附随时间成为权利基础与许可起点的客观凭据。

title: 版本与许可证变更的痕迹
issue: 同上公证记录逐字：“2.2016年9月10日，Lody将LGPL3.0协议变更为GPL3.0协议。”“9.2017年10月29日，Lody删除GPL3.0协议。”；法院据此认定后续版本仍受 GPL3.0 约束——许可更替与删除的平台痕迹用于判定适用版本。

title: 证据不足的程序后果
issue: CAFC 逐字：“the District Court did not make factual findings on the likelihood of success on the merits”且“we remand to enable the District Court to determine whether Jacobsen has demonstrated (1) a likelihood of success on the merits and either a presumption of irreparable harm or a demonstration of irreparable harm”——未认定即退回补证。

title: 版权归属判决的延伸适用
issue: 十巡 2011 维持：“The jury found Novell had not transferred the copyrights to SCO”“We affirm.”；二巡 2026 并援引 SCO 判例线（引“SCO Group, 879 F.3d at 1079”）——版权归属认定延伸适用至后续争点。

title: 派生作品归属的判准
issue: 归属判准两源：CAFC 要求改动追踪（“tracking of modifications from the original computer files”）；2063 号判决以来源标注定权属（鉴定意见逐字：“双方对应目录中同时有‘lody’目录”且“罗盒公司代码中均有注释”）——判准取自生效许可条款与在案标注。

title: 早期定性的引用惯例
issue: 违约定性传统仍被引用并与改判并存：207 号逐字：“GPL V3协议具有合同性质，据此，GPL V3协议属于附解除条件的著作权合同”且“违约救济和侵权救济...两者竞合，由当事人自行选择”；CAFC 则立条件／契约两分之版权路径——两层解释并存。

title: 判例群的类型分布
issue: 类型分布为综述概括，无单一可核事实；已核延伸判例主轴（Novell 版权归属 2010-2011、BusyBox 系列和解、Skype 上诉撤回、VirtualApp 权属）与“版权归属、合同救济、侵权救济”三类归纳相容。

title: 同意令划出的计算机业务禁区
issue: 同意令经营范围限定获三源逐字：Ars Technica（2011-07-19）引判决要求“stay out of ‘any business other than the furnishing of common carrier communications services’”；Salus（；login 2015-04）引“enjoined AT&T/Western Electric from ‘commencing…manufacture for sale or lease any equipment’ other than that used in telephony or telegraphy”；“联邦项目”一面由独立法律分析（itreview.org，2004-05-25）逐字“Under the decree, Bell Labs was limited to doing research for AT&T or contract work for the federal government”坐实；计算机业务禁区与 UNIX 只能以许可方式外放的因果三源一致。

title: 大学许可的四项附加条件
issue: 四项条件逐字坐实：Ars Technica 引 AT&T/Unix 营销政策回顾报告原文四条并列“No advertising / No support / No bug fixes / Payment in advance”；Klara Systems（2020-10-20）独立转述“no advertising, no support, no bug fixes, payment in advance”；TUHS 藏 Pomerantz 论文（2004）另引 AT&T 软件销售负责人 Otis Wilson 口径“As is, no support, payment in advance!”互证。thesis“不修错”即 no bug fixes，逐字对应。

title: 源代码版权标注的登记惯例
issue: 发行件以文件头声明标注权属一手坐实：DragonFly COPYRIGHT（V51—V53 已验底座，本次实取）载 Regents 版权块“Copyright 1979, 1980, 1983, 1986, 1988, 1989, 1991, 1992, 1993, 1994 The Regents of the University of California. All rights reserved.”；OpenBSD 版权政策逐字“The ‘copyright notices’ usually included in source files are not copyrights, but rather notices that a party asserts that they hold copyright to the material or to part of the material”；标注与权属判定的关联由 1993 年地院 opinion 侧证：其列明“AT & T has received copyright certificates of registration on various versions of UNIX software and documentation”为原告权利主张基础，且 TUHS COPYRIGHTS 明示权属判定以逐文件标注为起点（“Please read the individual software files to determine ownership and copyright status”）。

title: 许可条款里衍生作品的边界
issue: “实质派生”边界一手坐实：1992-07-24 USL 第一次修正诉状（D.N.J. 92-1667 DRD）逐字“based upon, substantially copied from or derived from UNIX(R) system software”；1993 年 Debevoise opinion 逐字引许可边界“The 32V agreement permits the Regents to create derivatives of UNIX and, to the extent that the derivatives are free of proprietary information, to distribute them without restriction.”——派生是否“不含专有信息”即争议入口；TUHS COPYRIGHTS 沿用同一边界语“substantially derived from the Novell UNIX systems above”。

title: 授权费用与商用定价的落差
issue: 价差一手坐实：McKusick《Twenty Years of Berkeley Unix》逐字“BSDI began selling their system including both source and binaries in January 1992 for $995. They began running advertisements touting their 99% discount over the price charged for System V source plus binary systems.”——99% 折扣即约百倍价差；1993 年地院 opinion 载 McKusick 宣誓书口径“the cost of an AT & T UNIX license had increased to around $200,000”，与 995 美元整套发行比超两百倍，“近百倍”为保守下限；独立法律分析（itreview.org）逐字“licensed from UC Berkeley for a one-time $500 or $1,000 fee was sub-licensed by Unix Systems Laboratories for as much as $200,000 per license”互证。

title: 伯克利系统的 AT&T 代码基线
issue: McKusick 逐字“Up through the release of 4.3BSD-Tahoe, all recipients of BSD had to first get an AT&T source license. That was because the BSD systems were never released by Berkeley in a binary-only format; the distributions always contained the complete source to every part of the system.”；FreeBSD《Explaining BSD》逐字“The BSD tapes contained AT&T source code and thus required a UNIX® source license.”——基线版本决定回标义务成立。

title: 伯克利自写部分的权利归属
issue: TUHS 档案 COPYRIGHTS 文件逐字“those portions of 1BSD, 2BSD, 2.xBSD, 3BSD and 4.xBSD which are not substantially derived from the Novell UNIX systems above are either copyright the Regents of the University of California, or by the authors of the software”——“或归加州大学董事会、或归各作者”逐字坐实；4.4BSD/Lite 的 Regents 统一版权块另见 DragonFly COPYRIGHT。

title: 发行版序列的累积层序
issue: McKusick 全序列：1BSD（1977）“This first distribution included the Pascal system”→“The result of the update was the ‘Second Berkeley Software Distribution,’ a name that was quickly shortened to 2BSD”→1979-12“Joy shipped the first of nearly a hundred copies of 3BSD”→1980-10“released as 4BSD”→1981-06“released as 4.1BSD”→1983-08“the system was released as 4.2BSD”→1986-06 4.3BSD→1988-06 Tahoe→Net/1→Reno→Net/2→4.4BSD-Lite，增量累积层序完整可考。

title: 386BSD 的替换与重写作业
issue: McKusick 逐字“Within six months of the release, Bill Jolitz had written replacements for the six missing files. He promptly released a fully compiled and bootable system for the 386-based PC architecture which he called 386/BSD.”；《Explaining BSD》逐字“One of the CSRG members, William F. Jolitz, wrote the remaining code and released it in early 1992 as 386BSD.”；夫妇分工由 Klara（2020）转述“Bill and Lynne Jolitz started working on creating a full release. They began by removing and replacing the pieces that had unsatisfactory licenses or no longer worked the way they should.”

title: 起诉案由与请求内容
issue: 1992-07-24 第一次修正诉状诉因十一项在案：违约、引诱违约、联邦版权侵权、商业秘密侵占、Lanham 法虚假陈述两项、虚假来源标注两项、联邦商标侵权（1-800-ITS-UNIX）、淡化、不正当竞争；诉状逐字主张 BSD/386“admittedly derived from the Networking Release 2 software”且“based upon, substantially copied from or derived from UNIX(R) system software”，请求禁令等救济；McKusick 逐字“filed suit to enjoin BSDI from selling their product. The suit alleged that the BSDI product contained proprietary USL code and trade secrets.”

title: 诉前警告的两项要求
issue: McKusick 逐字“The letter demanded that they stop promoting their product as Unix and in particular that they stop using the deceptive phone number. Although the phone number was promptly dropped and the advertisements changed to explain that the product was not Unix”——两项要求逐字坐实；Klara（2020）独立转述“demanding that BSDi do two things: drop the 1-800-ITS-Unix phone number and make it clear in the advertisements that BSDi's product was not Unix”；法院记录补证 1992-04-29 协定“the parties agreed to a court-ordered stipulation that BSDI would cease using the phone number ‘1-800-ITS-UNIX.’”

title: 新泽西地院的管辖选择
issue: 管辖与主营业地：1993 年 Debevoise opinion 逐字“Plaintiff Unix System Laboratories (“USL”) is a Delaware corporation with its principal place of business in Summit, New Jersey.”，案号 Civ. No. 92-1667，法院 D.N.J.；评议与裁决：McKusick 逐字“In December 1992, Dickinson R. Debevoise, a United States District Judge in New Jersey, heard the arguments for the injunction… On a Friday about six weeks later, he issued a forty-page opinion in which he denied the injunction and threw out all but two of the complaints. The remaining two complaints were narrowed to recent copyrights and the possibility of the loss of trade secrets.”

title: 加州大学反诉的权利主张
issue: McKusick 逐字“The University's suit claimed that USL had failed in their obligation to provide due credit to the University for the use of BSD code in System V as required by the license that they had signed with the University.”；UC 官方新闻稿（1994-02-06）逐字“It also brought a separate action against USL alleging that USL had violated the terms of its Berkeley Software Distribution… license agreements by failing to give the University credit for certain material in the UNIX release.”反诉把争点反转为 USL 合规问题成立。

title: 六份内核文件作为争点核心
issue: McKusick 逐字“we discovered that there were only six remaining kernel files that were still contaminated and which could not be trivially rewritten”及“The judge agreed with BSDI's argument and told USL that they would have to restate their complaint based solely on the six files or he would dismiss it.”；《Explaining BSD》补证缺口规模“Net/2 was not a complete operating system: about 20% of the kernel code was missing.”——争点收窄到可逐份核对的规模成立。

title: 和解协议的三文件删除清单
issue: McKusick 逐字“The result was that three files were removed from the 18,000 that made up Networking Release 2, and a number of minor changes were made to other files.”；UC 官方新闻稿（1994-02-06）逐字“The settlement restricts further use and distribution of certain files in the Second Networking Release”；Klara（2020）独立转述“Only three files had to be removed from Networking Release 2 and changes were made to other files.”

title: 版权补注的七十份文件清单
issue: McKusick 逐字“In addition, the University agreed to add USL copyrights to about 70 files, although those files continued to be freely redistributed.”；UC 新闻稿逐字“requires that certain files in 4.4 BSD-Lite include a USL copyright notice”；OpenBSD 版权政策独立旁证逐字“As part of its settlement with AT&T, Berkeley included an AT&T copyright notice on some of the files in 4.4BSD lite and lite2. The terms of this license are identical to the standard Berkeley license.”——“补注不改变可再分发地位”坐实。

title: 代码溯源审计的作业程序
issue: 诉讼促成的归并义务一手坐实：McKusick 逐字“The lawsuit settlement also stipulated that USL would not sue any organization using 4.4BSD-Lite as the base for their system. So, all the BSD groups that were doing releases at that time, BSDI, NetBSD, and FreeBSD, had to restart their code base with the 4.4BSD-Lite sources into which they then merged their enhancements and improvements.”；逐文件重核与剔除纪律由 OpenBSD 版权政策逐字佐证：“OpenBSD cannot include material which includes copyrights which are more restrictive than the Berkeley copyright, or must relegate this material to a secondary status”及“In general OpenBSD does not include material copyrighted by manufacturers or software houses.”注：FreeBSD 侧为重启 Lite 的逐文件归并（间接），OpenBSD 侧为成文审查政策（直接）。

title: 清理延宕对发行节奏的影响
issue: Klara（2020）逐字“It effectively stalled development on BSD for several years. No one wanted to risk getting pulled into the lawsuit.”——“无人愿被卷入”与“数年”逐字对应；McKusick 逐字“While this reintegration caused a short-term delay in the development of the various BSD systems”补证归并延迟；4.4BSD-Lite 于 1994-06 发行（“was released in June 1994”），在 1994 年 1—2 月和解之后，“净版发行被迫推迟到和解之后”坐实。

title: 版权标注不全的登记缺口
issue: TUHS 档案 COPYRIGHTS 文件（Warren Toomey 署名）自认遗漏并公开征集，逐字：“There are bound to be omissions of copyright in this file. Please email me if there are other copyright notices that can be added here. Warren Toomey, wkt@tuhs.org”——“档案整理者自认版权标注必有遗漏并公开征集补正”逐字坐实。

title: USL 转手至 Novell 的时点
issue: 十巡 2011 判决逐字“In 1993, Novell purchased the UNIX program development and licensing business from AT&T for over $300 million.”；McKusick 逐字“The CEO of Novell, Ray Noorda, stated publicly that he would rather compete in the marketplace than in court.”；UC 新闻稿逐字“Ray Noorda, Chairman of Novell, Inc., which recently acquired USL, called the settlement an ‘excellent example of what can be accomplished by cooperation between the business and academic communities.’”三源互证。

title: 交割后版权归属的说明
issue: TUHS 档案 COPYRIGHTS 文件逐字“Novell owns the copyright on these versions of UNIX (as well as others): 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th & 7th Editions, PWB/UNIX, Mini UNIX, and 32V.”——“档案方以‘Novell 拥有这些版本版权’一句概括交割结果”逐字坐实。

title: 商标与源码权利的初次分离
issue: TUHS COPYRIGHTS 同段两句并列逐字：“UNIX is a registered trademark in the United States and other countries, licensed exclusively through X/Open Company, Ltd. Novell owns the copyright on these versions of UNIX…”——商标独家许可与源码版权分属两主体逐字坐实；Open Group 法务 FAQ 确认该旧署名口径“licensed exclusively through X/Open Company Ltd”为 X/Open 承接时期的规范表述。

title: 许可费流的二元结构
issue: 两套价目并存坐实：源码许可按套计价（1993 年地院 opinion 载“the cost of an AT & T UNIX license had increased to around $200,000”）与整套发行定价分立（McKusick：BSDi 1992-01 起售价 995 美元、自宣 99% 折扣）；许可费流的独立存在另由十巡 2011 判决逐字“Novell retained the right to the royalties collected by SCO on SVRX licenses with a 5% administrative fee”补证。

title: 旧版源码的后续开放许可
issue: Caldera 许可函原件（2002-01-23，TUHS Archive 收藏）逐字“Caldera International, Inc. hereby grants a fee free license that includes the rights use, modify and distribute this named source code, including creating derived binary products created from the source code”，覆盖“16 bit UNIX Versions 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7”与 32V，随附四条 BSD 式声明（含广告致谢条“This product includes software developed or owned by Caldera International, Inc.”）；TUHS COPYRIGHTS 逐字“In 2002, Caldera provided a BSD-style source license for these systems.”；OpenBSD 版权政策逐字“The original Unix code (AT&T versions 1 through 7 UNIX, including 32V) was freed by Caldera, Inc. on 23 January 2002 and is now available under a 4-term BSD-style license.”

title: Caldera 继承主张的起点
issue: 承接链与主张并行坐实：Pinsent Masons（2004-02-09）逐字“The Santa Cruz Operation sold on these rights to Caldera International, which subsequently changed its name to The SCO Group (SCO).”；SCO 新闻稿（2003-11-18，Groklaw 档）逐字“Code that has been identified includes Unix System V code as well as copyrighted code included in the 1994 settlement between Unix Systems Laboratories, Inc. and Berkeley Software Design, Inc. SCO acquired this code and associated copyrights in 1995 from Novell.”——旧版源码许可（2002 Caldera 函）与版权主张（同一 1995 交割文件链）并行成立。

title: 版权归属主张的三项依据
issue: “2003 年诉 IBM 索赔五十亿美元”与一手相悖：Pinsent Masons（2004-02-09）逐字记载索赔升级序列——“In March 2003 SCO accused IBM… SCO sued for $1 billion”；“In June, SCO amended the suit… SCO also upped its claim to at least $3 billion”；“the SCO Group sought to amend its suit against IBM by adding two counts of copyright infringement and increasing the claim from $3 billion to a possible $5 billion in damages”（2004-02-06 递交）——五十亿美元系 2004 年修状新增版权诉因的口径，非 2003 年起诉时索赔额。1994 年和解的援引属实：SCO 新闻稿（2003-11-18，Groklaw 档）逐字“copyrighted code included in the 1994 settlement between Unix Systems Laboratories, Inc. and Berkeley Software Design, Inc. SCO acquired this code and associated copyrights in 1995 from Novell.”——但系 SCO 作为权利依据援引（主张材料）；和解文本公开后亦被用于限定 SCO 权利边界（LWN 2004-11-28 转述：“USL preserves its rights against licensees under the license agreements. I see no expanded rights against third parties”），题内“抗辩材料”定性与两用实态不符，宜随年份一并修正。〔已采纳落账 2026-11-01〕
suggested_title: 版权索赔升级与和解援引

title: 犹他州诉讼的权利基础
issue: 犹他州两案与权利基础坐实：十巡 2011 判决（SCO v Novell，D. Utah 2:04-CV-00139-TS）逐字“Claiming it owned the copyrights to UNIX and Novell had no right under the APA to waive its claims against IBM, SCO sued Novell for slander of title”——APA 解释同为 IBM 线与 Novell 线的权利基础；同判决逐字“SCO had sued IBM for violating its UNIX license by contributing proprietary code to Linux”；Red Hat 线由 Pinsent Masons 逐字“Linux distributor Red Hat has launched its own suit against SCO, and Novell and SCO are in dispute over who actually owns the intellectual property rights in the UNIX system.”三线并存坐实。

title: 主张与判决之间的距离
issue: thesis 表述与判决相悖：十巡 2011-08-30 判决逐字载 APA“specifically excluded ‘[a]ll copyrights and trademarks, except for the trademarks UNIX and UnixWare’ from the sale”——版权整体被排除于资产转让之外，仅 UNIX 与 UnixWare 两项商标随资产归 SCO；判决逐字“The jury found Novell had not transferred the copyrights to SCO”且“Our review… We affirm.”——终审维持 Novell 保留 UNIX 各版版权（含 UNIX 与 UnixWare 版本），SCO 主张被驳回。thesis“Novell 保留了 UNIX 与 UnixWare 版权之外的其他权利”方向颠倒（Novell 恰恰保留版权，SCO 所得为两项商标而非版权），须改。〔已采纳落账 2026-11-01〕〔C8b 破簇定题：版权未随资产转移的终审结论〕
suggested_title: 版权未随资产转移的终审认定

title: 版权链叙述的对立版本
issue: 对立两说一手坐实：主张侧——十巡判决逐字“SCO argues the district court erred… because the evidence showed ownership of the copyrights was ‘required for SCO to exercise its rights’”及“SCO contends the changes to the transfer were mere financing accommodations while Novell argues the deal was completely restructured and valuable assets, including the copyrights, were held back”；叙述侧——TUHS COPYRIGHTS 逐字“Novell owns the copyright on these versions of UNIX”；分歧确落在交割文本措辞（原版 APA 排除条款 vs Amendment No. 2）上。

title: 逐文件版权标注的核对
issue: McKusick 逐字“Karels, Bostic, and I spent the next several months going over the entire distribution, file by file, removing code that had originated in the 32/V release.”——以文件为单元的核对工序逐字坐实；OpenBSD 版权政策对声明层辨析逐字“The ‘copyright notices’ usually included in source files are not copyrights, but rather notices that a party asserts that they hold copyright to the material or to part of the material”——核对落到声明层。

title: 来源不明文件的重写处置
issue: McKusick 逐字“we discovered that there were only six remaining kernel files that were still contaminated and which could not be trivially rewritten. While we considered rewriting those six files so that we could release a complete system, we decided instead to release just what we had.”——无法以重写消除疑点的文件不留在发行件内；批量重写工序由 Bostic 征集逐字“He solicited folks to rewrite the Unix utilities from scratch based solely on their published descriptions.”坐实。

title: 第三方代码的剔除与替换
issue: 第三方代码剔除纪律逐字坐实：OpenBSD 版权政策“In general OpenBSD does not include material copyrighted by manufacturers or software houses. Material may be included where the copyright owner has granted general permission for reuse without conditions, with terms similar to the Berkeley copyright…”；替换清单与重写规模由 McKusick 逐字“Soon the list crossed one hundred utilities and within 18 months nearly all the important utilities and libraries had been rewritten.”（Bostic 征集名单）坐实。

title: 代码来源台账的编制规程
issue: TUHS COPYRIGHTS 即此台账形态，逐字：“Any portions of 1BSD, 2BSD, 2.xBSD, 3BSD and 4.xBSD which are substantially derived from the Novell UNIX systems above are also copyright Novell. Depending on where the software was developed, those portions of 1BSD, 2BSD, 2.xBSD, 3BSD and 4.xBSD which are not substantially derived from the Novell UNIX systems above are either copyright the Regents of the University of California, or by the authors of the software. Please read the individual software files to determine ownership and copyright status.”——“实质派生／非派生”两类归口与逐文件判定标准逐字坐实。

title: 审计结果公开的渠道
issue: 公开渠道坐实：TUHS COPYRIGHTS 为公开可取的归口台账并公开征集补正（“Please email me if there are other copyright notices that can be added here”）；重写贡献名单公开规则由 McKusick 逐字“Their only compensation would be to have their name listed among the Berkeley contributors next to the name of the utility that they rewrote.”坐实；OpenBSD 版权政策本身即项目公开政策页，清理口径对公众可核。

title: 独立树形成的技术前提
issue: McKusick 逐字“Within six months of the release, Bill Jolitz had written replacements for the six missing files. He promptly released a fully compiled and bootable system for the 386-based PC architecture which he called 386/BSD.”；《Explaining BSD》逐字“Net/2 was not a complete operating system: about 20% of the kernel code was missing. One of the CSRG members, William F. Jolitz, wrote the remaining code and released it in early 1992 as 386BSD.”——重写缺口部件并补齐发行件为自举前提坐实。

title: 净版作为独立树的起点
issue: McKusick 逐字“The result was that three files were removed from the 18,000 that made up Networking Release 2… The newly blessed release was called 4.4BSD-Lite and was released in June 1994 under terms identical to those used for the Networking releases.”；UC 新闻稿逐字“The settlement clears the way for the University to release a new, unencumbered version of the Berkeley 4.4 BSD operating system software, to be called 4.4 BSD-Lite.”且“4.4 BSD-Lite will not require a license from nor payment of royalties to USL.”——删除与改动之后方有可脱离 AT&T 许可的完整树。

title: 剩余 AT&T 代码的分布
issue: TUHS COPYRIGHTS 逐字“Any portions of 1BSD, 2BSD, 2.xBSD, 3BSD and 4.xBSD which are substantially derived from the Novell UNIX systems above are also copyright Novell.”——残余分布与回标规则逐字坐实；Lite 内 AT&T 注记由 OpenBSD 政策逐字“As part of its settlement with AT&T, Berkeley included an AT&T copyright notice on some of the files in 4.4BSD lite and lite2.”补证；清理深度对照由 McKusick 口径坐实（Net/2 仅余六份受染内核文件）。

title: 树内版权声明的分层
issue: 分层标注一手坐实：DragonFly COPYRIGHT 同件并列 DragonFly Project（2003—2026）、UC Regents（1979—1994）与 IEEE/CBEMA 转载许可三段，另设“Authors of new code”署名段；TUHS COPYRIGHTS 逐字“Depending on where the software was developed, those portions… are either copyright the Regents of the University of California, or by the authors of the software.”——“按开发地分别标注”逐字坐实。

title: 独立树对后续发行的约束
issue: TUHS COPYRIGHTS 逐字“Novell owns the copyright on these versions of UNIX (as well as others)”；版权保留经 SCO 时代争议延续至终审（十巡 2011 维持版权未随资产转移）；独立树的行动边界由和解不诉条款坐实：McKusick 逐字“The lawsuit settlement also stipulated that USL would not sue any organization using 4.4BSD-Lite as the base for their system.”——“只能在不触碰这些版本的前提下发行”成立。

title: 诉讼期间开发停滞的后果
issue: Klara（2020）逐字“It effectively stalled development on BSD for several years. No one wanted to risk getting pulled into the lawsuit.”；当事人（BSDI 技术主管 Paul Borman，Metro 2000 专访）逐字“That lawsuit really harmed BSDI because we spent all this money we didn't have, and we couldn't move forward with our code.”——停滞与发行文档让位双面坐实。

title: 贡献者流向 Linux 的转折
issue: “把地盘让给 Linux”逐字坐实：Klara（2020）引 FreeBSD 创始人 Jordan Hubbard 口径“effectively ceded the territory to Linux during a critical period in which there was a leadership vacuum and lots of Fear, Uncertainty and Doubt in the BSD community”（该文拼写为“Jordan Huddard”系笔误，指 Hubbard）；Hubbard 本人 2000 年专访（Metro）另证时窗逐字“Linux was lucky… By the time the suit was over, we were two years behind.”——关键窗口与人力流向改写两说齐备。

title: 许可不确定性对商业采用的抑制
issue: Novell 表态逐字坐实：McKusick“The CEO of Novell, Ray Noorda, stated publicly that he would rather compete in the marketplace than in court.”；权属风险计入后续判断的余波由《Explaining BSD》逐字“the spectre of the litigation continues to haunt people. In March 2000 an article published on the web claimed that the court case had been ‘recently settled’.”补证。

title: 判决先例对后续许可争议的作用
issue: 和解规模逐字坐实（McKusick：三份文件自 18,000 份中删除、约 70 份补注 USL 版权）；条款范围成为后续争议比对基准由 LWN（2004-11-28）逐字坐实——和解文本公开后直接用于解读 SCO 诉讼边界：“Now we know why SCO keeps telling us the case is ‘just a contract’ case… USL preserves its rights against licensees under the license agreements. I see no expanded rights against third parties…”

title: BSD 法律地位的重新确认
issue: 法律地位重确认三步齐备：UC 新闻稿逐字“The settlement clears the way for the University to release a new, unencumbered version of the Berkeley 4.4 BSD operating system software, to be called 4.4 BSD-Lite.”；McKusick 逐字“The newly blessed release was called 4.4BSD-Lite…”；版权面貌的最终厘清由 1999-07-22 UC 技术许可办公室函（DragonFly COPYRIGHT 收录，William Hoskins 署名）逐字“Effective immediately, licensees and distributors are no longer required to include the acknowledgement within advertising materials. Accordingly, the foregoing paragraph of those BSD Unix files containing it is hereby deleted in its entirety.”完成广告条废止。

title: 著作权与商标权的对象差别
issue: 表达与思想界线逐字：17 U.S.C. §102(b)“In no case does copyright protection for an original work of authorship extend to any idea, procedure, process, system, method of operation, concept, principle, or discovery, regardless of the form in which it is described, explained, illustrated, or embodied in such work.”；商标对象逐字（USPTO）：“A word, phrase, design, or a combination that identifies your goods or services, distinguishes them from the goods or services of others, and indicates the source of your goods or services.”——保护对象不重叠（表达 vs 来源识别）官方口径坐实。

title: 创作要件与使用要件
issue: 著作权要件逐字（Feist v. Rural，499 U.S. 340 (1991) 判决要旨）：“The constitutional requirement necessitates independent creation plus a modicum of creativity.”——独立创作＋最低创造性坐实；商标要件逐字（USPTO《Basic Facts about Trademarks》）：“You can establish ‘common law’ rights in a mark based solely on use of the mark in commerce, without a registration.”——使用取得坐实；识别力要求同册“identifies and distinguishes the source of the goods of one party from those of others”。

title: 商标权利的属地限度
issue: USPTO《Basic Facts about Trademarks》逐字：联邦注册优势首项为“A legal presumption of your ownership of the mark and your exclusive right to use the mark nationwide on or in connection with the goods/services listed in the registration (whereas a state registration only provides rights within the borders of that one state, and common law rights exist only for the specific area where the mark is used)”——未注册（普通法）权利只及于实际使用地域、更强保护须另行取得逐字坐实；同册另证“common law rights are based solely on use of the mark in commerce within a particular geographic area”。

title: 名称与短语的排除清单
issue: 37 C.F.R. §202.1(a) 逐字：“Words and short phrases such as names, titles, and slogans; familiar symbols or designs…”列于“Material not subject to copyright”首项——名称、短句与口号不入著作权保护坐实；另循商标路径由 USPTO 口径补证（“A trademark typically protects brand names and logos used on goods and services.”）。

title: 两类权利的并用场合
issue: 并用场合坐实：USPTO 以同一产品并列两权为例（“you would apply to register a trademark to protect the brand name of the vacuum cleaner. And you might register a copyright for the TV commercial that you use to market the product.”）；同一图形标识的双重保护由 FreeBSD 基金会条款坐实——“FreeBSD Project Logo”经注册为商标（terms：“including the below marks that are currently registered and/or otherwise being used”），而图形作品属 17 U.S.C. §102(a)(5)“pictorial, graphic, and sculptural works”保护对象；并用时的分辨依据即两法对象定义（§102(b) 排除 vs 商标来源指示）。

title: 发行版名称的序列用法
issue: McKusick 序列命名与 AT&T 异议逐字：“The original intent had been to call it the 5BSD release; however, there were objections from AT&T that there would be customer confusion between their commercial Unix release, System V, and a Berkeley release named 5BSD. So, to resolve the issue, Berkeley agreed to change the naming scheme for future releases to stay at 4BSD and just increment the minor number.”——名称作版本序列识别手段、未按商标运营的用法坐实。

title: 名称与出品方的标注关系
issue: 名称指向出品方以标注为载体坐实：4.4BSD/Lite 统一版权块致谢条（DragonFly COPYRIGHT 收录）“This product includes software developed by the University of California, Berkeley and its contributors.”；《Open Group Base Specifications Issue 7》（2018）商标页逐字“BSD™ is a trademark of the University of California, Berkeley, USA.”——以 ™（未注册、使用取得）标示；其排他限度即 USPTO《Basic Facts》所述“common law rights exist only for the specific area where the mark is used”。

title: 名称背书禁令的条款形态
issue: 背书禁令条款逐字（DragonFly COPYRIGHT 收录之 4.4BSD/Lite 条款）：“3. Neither the name of the University nor the names of its contributors may be used to endorse or promote products derived from this software without specific prior written permission.”——名称使用被许可条款直接约束坐实；1999-07-22 废止函仅删广告致谢条（第 3 条致谢项），本背书禁令条独立存续。

title: 标识归属的分散状态
issue: 归属分散逐字坐实：TUHS COPYRIGHTS“those portions… which are not substantially derived from the Novell UNIX systems above are either copyright the Regents of the University of California, or by the authors of the software”；DragonFly COPYRIGHT 致谢条“and its contributors”与各文件头作者版权并存——标识随代码归属分散成立。

title: 名称保护的法律空档
issue: 未注册状态有正面一手：《Open Group Base Specifications Issue 7》（2018，POSIX.1-2017）商标页逐字“BSD™ is a trademark of the University of California, Berkeley, USA.”——同页 UNIX®、UNIXWARE® 用 ®，BSD 用 ™，即使用取得的未注册商标主张（USPTO《Basic Facts》：“If not yet registered, use TM for goods or SM for services, to indicate that you have adopted this as a trademark”）；“长期未注册”以该 2018 年权威文本仍标 ™ 为直接证据（早年注册簿未逐档检索，为限度注记）；“空档使第三方使用难以阻却”与普通法权利地域限度（“common law rights exist only for the specific area where the mark is used”）相合。

title: 商标归属的转移链条
issue: The Open Group 平台页逐字“The UNIX trademark is owned and managed by The Open Group on behalf of the industry to signify products that are certified to conform to the Single UNIX Specification.”——“代表行业持有”逐字坐实；法务 FAQ 确认正确署名“UNIX is a registered trademark of The Open Group in the United States and other countries”。

title: 独家许可的授权结构
issue: TUHS COPYRIGHTS（档案方）逐字“UNIX is a registered trademark in the United States and other countries, licensed exclusively through X/Open Company, Ltd.”——经 X/Open 独家许可逐字坐实，且与同文件“Novell owns the copyright”并置，商标权与源码权持有主体分离成立；Open Group 法务 FAQ 确认该旧署名出自“licenses (which date from before the merger of X/Open Company with The Open Group)”。

title: 商标注册的类别划分
issue: 注册清单逐字坐实：《Open Group Base Specifications Issue 7》商标页“UNIX®, UNIXWARE®, X/Open®, and The Open Brand X® logo are registered trademarks… of The Open Group”——UNIX 与 UNIXWARE 为注册商标要项；注册地域由法务 FAQ“in the United States and other countries”确认。

title: 认证与商标使用的绑定
issue: Open Group UNIX 认证页逐字“Only systems that are fully compliant and certified according to the Single UNIX Specification are qualified to use the UNIX® trademark.”——认证与商标使用绑定逐字坐实。

title: 商标争点在早期诉讼中的位置
issue: 1992-07-24 修正诉状商标类诉因逐字在案：联邦商标侵权（“Section 32, 15 U.S.C. §1114, re: ‘1-800-ITS-UNIX’”）、Lanham 法虚假或误导陈述两项（§43(a)，15 U.S.C. §1125）、虚假来源标注两项、淡化与不正当竞争——商标侵权与虚假广告同列诉因、与版权及商业秘密诉因同案并行坐实；1993 年 Debevoise opinion 亦单列 Count 6/8 商标诉由逐字在案。

title: 认证作为身份门槛
issue: Open Group 认证页逐字“Only systems that are fully compliant and certified according to the Single UNIX Specification are qualified to use the UNIX® trademark.”；认证标记的商标法定位由 USPTO 逐字补证：“Certification marks: These marks show consumers that particular goods or services, or the providers of the goods or services, have met certain standards set by a certifying organization.”——身份门槛机理坐实。

title: 规范版本与认证时点
issue: 以规范版本为基准逐字坐实：认证页“certified according to the Single UNIX Specification”；登记册条目以版本锚定（如“AIX version 7, at 7.2 TL5 (or later)”、“UnixWare ® 7.1.3 and later”、“z/OS 3.1 or later”）——规范换版带动认证时点前移由登记册版本序列可见。

title: 认证产品的登记册
issue: 公开登记册逐字坐实：认证页“To view the register of certified products see http://www.opengroup.org/openbrand/register”；登记册页自题“The Open Group official register of UNIX Certified Products”并逐条列示产品（IBM AIX/z/OS、HPE HP-UX、SCO UnixWare/OpenServer）——身份主张可被第三方逐一查验。

title: 未认证系统的命名空间
issue: FreeBSD《Explaining BSD》逐字“One detail that the lawsuit did clarify is the naming: in the 1980s, BSD was known as ‘BSD UNIX®’. With the elimination of the last vestige of AT&T code from BSD, it also lost the right to the name UNIX®. Thus you will see references in book titles to ‘the 4.3BSD UNIX® operating system’ and ‘the 4.4BSD operating system’.”——未认证者退回自称 BSD，UNIX 标记排他不及于 BSD 一词本身。

title: 商业 UNIX 的认证延续
issue: 登记册实测（2026-11-01）确证认证序列延续与 BSD 缺席：Open Group 官方登记册现列 IBM AIX 7／z/OS、HPE HP-UX 11i V3、The SCO Group“UnixWare ® 7.1.3 and later”与“SCO OpenServer Release 5 and OpenServer Release 6”，无任何 BSD 发行版条目；但“以 SVR5 内核承载认证”之表述未获一手：登记册与 Xinuos 产品页均未涉内核代际（回指本卷 V72.3.2.1 同口径存疑：sco.com/products 仅列类目、十巡/二巡判决未涉）；SVR5 内核命名待 UnixWare 7／OpenServer 6 技术白皮书原文补证后再定。〔2026-11-03 存疑清零：内核代际未证，题面收至登记册缺席〕

title: 商标注册的持有主体
issue: 基金会条款逐字：“The Foundation represents the Project in executing contracts, license agreements, and other legal arrangements which require a recognized legal entity, including granting licenses or permissions to use the FreeBSD trademarks, service marks and logos (collectively, the ‘FreeBSD Marks’), including the below marks that are currently registered and/or otherwise being used in the United States and other countries”，并列注册字标“FREEBSD (Word Mark)”；“All uses of the FreeBSD Marks, and all goodwill associated therewith, will inure solely to the benefit of the Foundation.”——持有主体（基金会）与项目治理主体分离坐实。

title: 标识与口号的注册边界
issue: 条款页并列三件逐字：“FREEBSD (Word Mark)”、“The FreeBSD Project Logo”（并注“You must include the registered mark (®) even when the logo is for personal use”）、“THE POWER TO SERVE (Word Mark)”，且声明“The Foundation has the following trademarks, service marks and logos in use in the United States and/or other countries”——权利范围自文字名称扩展至图形标识与口号坐实。

title: 使用条款的许可性质
issue: 许可性质逐字坐实：商业使用须“obtained explicit written permission from the Foundation”，且“The Foundation may grant or withhold permission for any such use in its sole discretion and withdraw permission at any time.”；不转移权利逐字：“Do not attempt to claim or assert any ownership rights in any of the FreeBSD Marks and do not attempt to register any of the FreeBSD Marks as a trademark, trade name, domain name, or ‘doing business as’ name, alone or (unless specifically licensed) in combination with your own trademarks.”

title: 商业再发行中的名称使用
issue: 指明来源的许可使用逐字：“Any individual, organization, or company may, without explicit permission from the Foundation, use the FreeBSD Marks to show support for the Project or as part of a notice to users that a product incorporates the FreeBSD operating system.”；背书禁令逐字：“Any use of or reference to the FreeBSD Marks that… suggests that the Foundation sponsors, endorses, or is affiliated with you, is prohibited.”——限于来源指明、不得据以主张背书坐实。

title: 商标管理与项目治理的衔接
issue: 两套治理衔接逐字坐实：条款页“The Foundation represents the Project in executing contracts, license agreements, and other legal arrangements… including granting licenses or permissions to use the FreeBSD trademarks”（商标集中管理）与“As a vendor-neutral organization, an important part of our brand is that FreeBSD projects are governed independently.”（项目独立治理）；代码层分散维护由《Explaining BSD》4.2 节 committer/core team 模型补证。

title: 形象著作权的持有者
issue: 持有者逐字坐实：FreeBSD 官方 Daemon 页“The copyright holder and creator of the daemon image is Marshall Kirk McKusick (mckusick@mckusick.com).”；McKusick 本人声明页“The BSD Daemon is copyrighted by Marshall Kirk McKusick.”；NetBSD 官网声明页“BSD Daemon Copyright (©) 1988 by Marshall Kirk McKusick. All Rights Reserved.”——形象权属（个人）与项目商标权属（基金会，见 2.5.1）分属不同主体成立。

title: 守护神名称的传说澄清
issue: McKusick Beastie 页逐字三句：“He is very proud of the fact that he does not have a name, he is just the BSD daemon.”、“If you insist on a name, call him beastie.”、“Contrary to a myth first started by some advertising droid at Walnut Creek, the daemon's name is NOT Chuck.”——本无正式名字、坊间所传之名（Chuck）源自发行商（Walnut Creek CDROM）广告、沿用以 beastie 为准逐字坐实。

title: 商用复制的事前许可
issue: 事前许可逐字坐实：McKusick 声明页“If you want to mass produce the daemon on Tshirts, CDROM's, etc you need to request permission in advance.”；许可渠道逐字（FreeBSD 官方页）：“Permission to use the daemon may be obtained from: Marshall Kirk McKusick 1614 Oxford St Berkeley, CA 94709-1608 USA or via email at mckusick@mckusick.com.”——逐案审查与私人渠道并存。

title: 维权经验与条款的收紧
issue: 持有者自述逐字坐实：McKusick 声明页（1995-01 署）“I regret having to be so legalistic about the daemon, but I almost lost the daemon to a certain large company because I failed to show due diligence in protecting it. So, I've taken due diligence seriously since then.”——几乎失去该形象的维权经历与其后条款严格化（事前书面许可制）的因果逐字在案。

title: 形象与商标的权属分工
issue: 分工坐实：形象侧受著作权约束（“The BSD Daemon is copyrighted by Marshall Kirk McKusick”，使用经其个人事前授权）；名称侧受商标约束（基金会“FREEBSD (Word Mark)”注册商标及其使用条款）；两权属主体不同（个人 vs 基金会），同一品牌下各司其职成立。

title: 商业系统中的 BSD 代码来源
issue: 商业系统以开源（BSD）代码为平台基础坐实：《Explaining BSD》逐字“There are also two additional BSD UNIX® operating systems which are not open source, BSD/OS and Apple's Mac OS® X”且“The BSD core of this operating system, Darwin, is available as a fully functional open source operating system”；Netflix 以 FreeBSD 承载推流基础设施的商用实态回指 V54 已证（freebsdfoundation.org/end-user-stories/netflix-case-study/）。

title: 厂商自有商标的叠加
issue: 叠加自有商标坐实：《Explaining BSD》产品层命名即 Apple 自有标记（“Apple's Mac OS® X”“Mac® line”），BSD 仅居核心层（Darwin）；xnu 内核 README（回指 V51 已证：raw.githubusercontent.com/apple-oss-distributions/xnu/main/README.md）自述 XNU 为 Mach 与 BSD 混合内核——产品品牌与 BSD 组件来源说明分层并存。

title: 商标声明页的第三方列表
issue: 商标声明页功能逐字坐实：《Explaining BSD》专节列第三方标记——“Many of the designations used by manufacturers and sellers to distinguish their products are claimed as trademarks. Where those designations appear in this document, and the FreeBSD Project was aware of the trademark claim, the designations have been followed by the ‘™’ or the ‘®’ symbol.”——并逐项列明 AMD、Apple、Intel、Oracle/Sun、The Open Group 等第三方权属，承担来源披露功能。

title: 代码来源与品牌归属的分离
issue: 分离坐实：《Explaining BSD》4.1 节逐字“No one person or corporation owns BSD. It is created and distributed by a community of highly technical and committed contributors all over the world.”（代码来源）对 4.4 节 Mac OS® X／BSD/OS 等产品品牌归属（厂商自有标记）——商业产品中两者分层并存。

title: 品牌借用对项目声誉的反馈
issue: 品牌影响随产品扩散坐实：Netflix 以 FreeBSD 承载其推流基础设施并经基金会案例页公开（回指 V54 已证）；macOS 内嵌 BSD 核心（Darwin）随 Apple 产品面扩散（《Explaining BSD》4.4 节）——开源代码平台化后品牌反馈的可核实例两枚。

title: 规范遵从与技术路径的差别
issue: 路线比较的方法论题（认证路线以规范遵从换取身份 vs BSD 路线以源码开放换取可改造性），无超出本卷已核事实的独立断言；认证路线与 BSD 路线的事实底座分别由 2.3—2.4（Open Group 认证条款）与 2.8.2（许可分野）承载，本节作分岔叙述框架，属体例自陈。

title: 许可证条款的分野
issue: 许可分野逐字坐实：《Explaining BSD》4.5 节“any derivative work of a product released under the GPL must also be supplied with source code if requested. By contrast, the BSD license is less restrictive: binary-only distributions are allowed.”；OpenBSD 版权政策“The GNU Public License and licenses modeled on it impose the restriction that source code must be distributed or made available for all works that are derivatives of the GNU copyrighted code.”；BSD 侧条款文本（保留版权声明与条件、无 copyleft）见 DragonFly COPYRIGHT 三条款；GPLv2 第 2 条原文回指 V51—V53 已证（gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html）。

title: 认证身份与自由发行的两难
issue: 比较方法题（认证的合规声明与版本固定 vs 自由发行的任意分叉，两者难以兼得），无独立外部事实断言；两难的事实前提分别由 2.4.2（规范版本与认证时点）与 2.8.2（许可分野）承载，本节为张力叙述框架，属体例自陈。

title: 商标约束对分发的实际影响
issue: 约束集中环节坐实：基金会条款禁止项全部落点于标记使用（“Do not use the FreeBSD Marks as part of your product name”“Do not use the FreeBSD Marks as your domain name”“Do not use the FreeBSD Marks as verbs or nouns”等），未涉代码分发；代码分发仅受版权许可条款约束（DragonFly COPYRIGHT：保留版权声明与条件即可再分发）——商标只约束名称使用而不约束代码分发成立。

title: 两条路线的长期并存
issue: 并行存续坐实：Open Group 官方登记册现行列 IBM AIX、HPE HP-UX、z/OS 与 SCO UnixWare/OpenServer（认证路线现行有效）；《Explaining BSD》4.4 节“In contrast to the numerous Linux distributions, there are only four major open source BSDs.”且各项目持续发行——两条路线同一时期并行存续、未致一方消失。

title: 表达与功能的分界
issue: 17 U.S.C. §102(b) 逐字：“In no case does copyright protection for an original work of authorship extend to any idea, procedure, process, system, method of operation, concept, principle, or discovery, regardless of the form in which it is described, explained, illustrated, or embodied in such work.”

title: 专利排他权的期限结构
issue: 35 U.S.C. §154(a)(1)：“the right to exclude others from making, using, offering for sale, or selling the invention…”；§154(a)(2)：“ending 20 years from the date on which the application for the patent was filed”——排他与期限逐字命中；⚠️“换取公开”的对价框架系学说表述，建议论题注

title: 同一程序的两类保护
issue: §102(b)（表达侧）与 §154(a)(2)（二十年期）两法定在档——两类保护对象与期限不重合由两条文并列支撑；⚠️“同一程序可同时受著作权与专利约束”的实务通说建议补一则判例或官方说明

issue: Apache 2.0 §2：“a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, no-charge, royalty-free, irrevocable copyright license to reproduce, prepare Derivative Works of…distribute the Work”——直接授予且逐案协商不涉的文本结构在档

title: 许可条款中的默示授权
issue: Apache 2.0 §3：“each Contributor grants…a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, no-charge, royalty-free, irrevocable…patent license”；GPLv3 §11：“Each contributor grants you a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free patent license”——随作品一并授予两源逐字命中

title: 专利授权的范围与例外
issue: Apache 2.0 §3：“irrevocable (except as stated in this section) patent license to make, have made, use, offer to sell, sell, import, and otherwise transfer the Work.”——不可撤销与例外限定逐字命中

issue: Apache 2.0 §2（copyright license）与 §3（patent license）同章并列——两类许可范围与主体一致由条文结构支撑

title: 专利诉讼触发的终止
issue: Apache 2.0 §3：“If You institute patent litigation against any entity (including a cross-claim or counterclaim in a lawsuit) alleging that the Work…constitutes direct or contributory patent infringement, then any patent licenses…shall terminate as of the date such litigation is filed.”——起诉即终止逐字命中

title: 终止设计的防御意图
issue: 终止条款文本在档（Apache §3）；OIN“to protect Open Source Software (OSS) from patent threats”同源——防御意图解读有据；⚠️“意在阻止许可方反噬共同体”系意图推断，建议论题注明归纳层

title: 终止条款的触发要件
issue: Apache 2.0 §3：“alleging that the Work…constitutes direct or contributory patent infringement”＋“(including a cross-claim or counterclaim in a lawsuit)”——直接侵权、共同侵权之诉与反诉三要件逐字命中

title: 专利池的防御功能
issue: OIN：“patent defense community”＋cross-license 机制（“Adding more participants in the OIN cross-license”）——交叉许可替代逐案谈判在档；⚠️“降低主张的预期收益”系功能归纳

title: 专利期限与许可期限的错位
issue: Apache 2.0 §3：“a perpetual…patent license”对 35 U.S.C. §154(a)(2)“ending 20 years from the date on which the application…was filed”——永久许可对二十年专利两原文并列

title: 主张与反诉的对称性
issue: Apache 2.0 §3：“including a cross-claim or counterclaim in a lawsuit”——反诉列为触发事由逐字命中；后果等同由“any patent licenses…terminate”统一表述支撑

title: 授权范围的默示限定
issue: Apache 2.0 §3：“where such license applies only to those patent claims licensable by such Contributor that are necessarily infringed by their Contribution(s) alone or by combination of their Contribution(s) with the Work…”——必要性限定逐字命中

title: 规避行为的禁止对象
issue: 17 U.S.C. §1201(a)(1)(A)：“No person shall circumvent a technological measure that effectively controls access to a work protected under this title.”——a 款禁止对象为行为本身逐字命中（工具交易另列 a(2)）

title: 三类受控行为的区分
issue: (a)(1) 规避访问、(a)(2) 访问工具交易、(b)(1) 权利保护工具交易三段文本均在档（(b)(1)：“protection afforded by a technological measure that effectively protects a right of a copyright owner”）；⚠️“规避复制权”作为独立行为禁令不成立——(b) 款仅禁工具交易，正文宜按 (a)(1)／(a)(2)／(b)(1) 原文结构写

title: 三年周期的例外机制
issue: §1201(a)(1)(C)／(D)：“the Librarian of Congress conducts a rulemaking every three years”＋exemption lasts“for the ensuing 3-year period”——三年周期逐字命中

title: 例外类别的判定主体
issue: §1201(a)(1)(C)：“upon the recommendation of the Register of Copyrights”＋“consult with the Assistant Secretary for Communications and Information of the Department of Commerce”——版权局评估建议、行政机关参与逐字命中；判定由 Librarian 作出

title: 禁令与救济的条款位置
issue: §1201(c)：“Nothing in this section shall affect rights, remedies, limitations, or defenses to copyright infringement, including fair use…”——存留条款逐字命中；⚠️“不改变技术措施本身的受保护地位”系 (c) 反面解读，建议论题落 (c) 原文

title: 例外类别的列举次序
issue: 2024 Final Rule：“it can be appropriate to refine a class by reference to the use or user in order to remedy the adverse effect”——类目按作品类型与使用／使用者限定逐字命中

title: 续期机制的实际运行
issue: Copyright Office 1201 页：“the Office will employ the streamlined process for renewing existing exemptions used in previous cycles. Renewed exemptions remain in force for an additional three-year period.”——简化续期逐字命中

title: 非侵权使用的认定门槛

title: 例外与市场影响的关联
issue: §1201(a)(1)(C)：“consult with the Assistant Secretary for Communications and Information of the Department of Commerce”＋五因素含“The effect of circumvention…on the market for or value of copyrighted works”——商务部与市场因素逐字命中

title: 豁免条款的设立理由
issue: §1201(j)：good faith testing/investigating/correcting security flaw or vulnerability 豁免逐字命中；§1201(c)(4)：“Nothing in this section shall…enlarge or diminish…rights of free speech or of the press”——表达自由关切在档；⚠️“直接取自第一修正案”系立法史表述，条文落点为 (c)(4) 与 (j)

title: 安全研究的法律风险
issue: §1201(a)(1)（规避禁令）与 (a)(2)（工具流通禁令）双禁令文本在档——风险双源结构成立

title: 披露行为的定性分歧
issue: (a)(2)(C)“marketed with…knowledge of its circumvention use”与 (j)(3) 信息使用因素并读——披露定性张力由条文支撑；⚠️“定性分歧左右研究者选择”系学说归纳，建议注明

issue: OIN 官网：“The new OIN 2.0 License Agreement must be signed by new and existing members.”——签署协议入会逐字命中；⚠️“互不主张”细则在协议文本内，页面未展开

issue: OIN 官网：“defense costs averaging $4 million per case”——量级估算逐字命中

issue: 35 U.S.C. §154(a)(1)：“the right to exclude others from making, using, offering for sale, or selling the invention…”——排他权范围逐字命中；⚠️“检索是风险管理的第一步”系方法论句
